integrity: Mathematical proof plus a standalone exact-rational certificate of the finite interval and inequality steps; computational checks do not establish the infinite prime-ratio lemma.
scientific_limitations: A one-parameter classification at t=-3, not a parameter-neighborhood theorem or monotonicity result. Relies analytically on a published consecutive-prime ratio bound and the prime number theorem. Prior-art comparisons remain subject to unindexed literature.
title: Fourteen connected components in the cubic unitary-divisor range
